newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong World says to proceed with offer.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong World says to proceed with offer.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries said on Tuesday that it was disappointed in the rejection of its C$488 million bid for Canada's Domco but that it would proceed with the offer.
Sommer Allibert, a French car parts maker that owns 69 percent of floor covering specialist Domco, said earlier in the day that it would not tender shares in Domco after the bid.
"We question whether such a rejection can be grounded in reason," Armstrong responded in a statement, noting that the rejection came less than 24 hours after it was announced.
"We don't believe that when all of the sharholders have been heard from, that this rejection can stand. Our offer will proceed," it continued.
Armstrong is a manufacturer and marketer of interior furnishings.
